method: For each acquired player credited in the receiving team's starting lineup during strictly post-trade regular-season weeks 1–14, subtract that week and player's position's median actual starter points across all ten teams. Positions QB, RB, WR, TE and DEF are separate. Sum the above/below-median values by receiving side. Position-median surplus is not replacement value, not a causal trade evaluation, does not value equal-start alternatives, keeper eligibility, FAAB, 2016–2019 ESPN, playoffs, bench points or same-week performances. Comparing it with the original 18-deal position-relative PAR is a sensitivity check only; the two formulas are not equivalent.
